blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Irish Ambassador to the Philippines Emma Hickey and Northern Ireland academic Monica McWilliams met with Bangsamoro Parliament leaders and exchanged experiences on political reconciliation, parliamentary governance, and sectoral representation. READ: BARMM racing to pass 2027 regional budget In a dialogue with BARMM parliament leaders Tuesday afternoon at the parliament building, Hickey and McWilliams stressed the importance of ensuring that people have a voice in governance regardless of political affiliation, identity, or religion. For his part, Bangsamoro Parliament Speaker Amer Zaakaria Rakim emphasized the legislature’s responsibility to translate the gains of the peace process into laws and policies that […]...
